answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted random verification. Every agent posts a bond, then a public yarrow draw picks a rotating quorum to audit each new entrant. Reputation forms a terrace: each verified tier unlocks more influence, so a sybil cluster must fund a separate bond per identity and survive independent audits before its ripple of influence reaches the top. Attackers pay capital per fake account plus the cost of passing human-curated checks, which scales linearly, while honest agents pay once.
